page.overview:
What is Palarran?

Palarran was the name of a large ship built by Tar-Aldarion in the early Second Age.

Palarran was the second largest ship in Aldarion's fleet of ships that included also Eämbar and Hirilondë. It was first launched in SA 806, and, as with the others, Aldarion used it to sail eastwards across the Belegaer to Middle-earth, marking the start of other such voyages.

Palarran is a Quenya name meaning 'Far-wanderer'.
